items.name: JSON-Based Recipe Pages
items.description: Recipe pages have been completely rebuilt to use a JSON-powered system. This allows recipes to be added, updated, and maintained more efficiently while improving scalability and consistency across the website.

items.name: Server-Driven Recipe Data
items.description: Recipe content is now loaded from structured data files, enabling easier management, better organization, and future expansion of recipe features.

items.name: Official Roblox App Released
items.description: Launched the Samson Recipes experience on Roblox, bringing recipe browsing and platform features into an interactive Roblox application.

items.name: Cross-Platform Expansion
items.description: The Samson Recipes platform now extends beyond the website, marking the beginning of expansion into additional platforms and experiences.

items.name: Folder Structure Overhaul
items.description: Project files have been reorganized into structured folders for improved clarity, scalability, and easier navigation across the codebase.

items.name: Minor Bug Fixes
items.description: Resolved several small issues affecting stability and UI behavior to improve overall smoothness and reliability.

items.name: Gold Era Begins
items.description: The Gold Era officially begins following the site reaching 100,000 total visits. This milestone marks a new phase focused on premium gold styling, refined visuals, and long-term growth and polish.

items.name: New Image Carousel
items.description: Introduced a brand-new image carousel, enabling smoother image browsing with responsive behavior across desktop and mobile devices.

items.name: Bottom Bar Bug Fixes & Remaster
items.description: Resolved multiple issues with the bottom navigation bar and remastered its behavior for improved reliability, layout stability, and consistency.

items.name: Small Update
items.description: This is a small update to show how frequently we update the site. Stay tuned for more!

items.name: Site Goal Display
items.description: The website now tracks and displays site-wide goals for everyone to see.

items.name: Automatic Goal Image Export
items.description: Site goals are automatically placed on a custom image for easy download and sharing. This feature is available only on the website.

items.name: Ads Added Across Site & App
items.description: Ads have been added to both the website and the app to help support ongoing and future development.

items.name: Powered by Monetag
items.description: Advertising is provided thanks to Monetag, helping maximize support for continued growth.

items.name: Enhanced Update Log
items.description: Implemented a comprehensive update log system.
